deploy.//healthcheckTimeout: G6/Hazard-2: the FULL image (Dockerfile.full) loads spaCy en_core_web_lg + scispaCy en_ner_bc5cdr_md + the ~1.4GB obi/deid_roberta_i2b2 transformer into RAM during FastAPI lifespan, BEFORE uvicorn accepts its first connection (so /healthz cannot answer until that finishes). Cold boots were taking long enough that the old 300s window marked a slow-but-healthy deploy FAILED while /redact was already serving 200s. Once TLS is added, that FAILED noise would hide a REAL cert failure. 900s gives a heavy cold boot generous headroom; a deploy that truly cannot serve still fails after 15 min.
deploy.//restartPolicy: ON_FAILURE with only a couple of retries: a slow boot is no longer counted as a failure (the wide healthcheck window absorbs it), so a restart here means a genuine crash. Keep retries low to avoid a thrash loop on a real, persistent boot error (e.g. a bad cert) — fail visibly instead of churning.
